note: Port San Luis Harbor District camping: a single row of back-in sites on the bluff side of Avila Beach Dr at Harford Landing, by the pier, looking across the road and revetment over San Luis Obispo Bay. 8 full-hookup sites; the other 12 are dry sites for rigs towing a registered boat. Fully self-contained rigs with built-in tanks only (no cassette or portable toilets, no tents). Restrooms, showers and laundry at the landing. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: $155 full hookup (+$13 reservation fee), 8 CG 50 A FHU + 12 boat-only dry sites (20, all back-in, 42-65 ft pads), online-only via Bonfire, 14-night limit, quarterly releases, year-round. Bayview confirmed at the actual camping row; the stored pin and evidence describe the neighbouring Harbor Terrace (Flying Flags) terraces, not this campground - pin move ~250 m.

NAME: '(Olde Port Beach)' in the stored name is wrong - the sites are at Harford Landing by Harford Pier, west of Fisherman's Beach; Olde Port Beach is ~0.5 km east. Suggested name: 'Port San Luis Harbor RV Camping (Harford Landing)'.

CRITERIA: CG pads 42-65 ft (a 23-ft rig fits any); the 12 TB sites require a registered boat on its trailer in the space, so only the 8 CG sites are usable without a boat. 'FULLY SELF-CONTAINED UNITS ONLY' with factory-installed black and grey tanks. Public agency (local), price gate does not apply.
